title: SOVOS · Mode 0 · Birth · First Coordinate
description: Mode 0 of the SOVOS substrate: the first coordinate. A new user enters and is given a deterministic position in J-space, anchored to a StateBus water event.
text: SOVOS · Mode 0 · Birth · First Coordinate ⟁ SOVOS · Mode 0 · Birth First coordinate in J-space · Mode 0 of 4 ① Identity Display name User ID (email, DID, or any stable string) Namespace sovos (default) iokfarm (koi farm) meok (MEOK Labs) csoai (CSOAI) defoneos (DEFONEOS) ⚡ BIRTH · Mint Coordinate ② Coordinate (J-space · Poincaré ball) ③ Bus Vector (StateBus append) Mode 0 · The birth event mints a deterministic coordinate inside the Poincaré ball (norm ≤ 0.85) and appends a "water" event to the StateBus. Same user_id + namespace always yields the same coordinate and chain_id. The coordinate is then the anchor for Modes 1 (chat) and 2 (tool call).
